en: Changed Monitor's WebSocket watch to follow a rule on every Bash command: a deny refuses it, and under an ask rule an allow on Monitor, bypass mode or auto mode no longer skips the prompt
zh: 变更 Monitor 的 WebSocket 监视，使其对每条 Bash 命令都遵循规则：deny 规则会拒绝该命令；在 ask 规则下，Monitor 上的 allow、bypass 模式或自动模式都不再跳过权限提示
